joe-messina.text: Campaign site priority: "Restoring FULL Parental Access" — "Parents have been demonized and voices have been silenced. I will continue to fight for you to be heard!"
"Better Parental Oversight of Curriculum": "Parents have a right to know what's being taught in the classroom and what's in the books your kids are reading. They are YOUR kids!"
Advocates "a return to the basics... REAL math, REAL science, and REAL history" and renewed Career Technical Education because "Not all students need or want to go to college."
Pledges to keep being "a watchdog over your tax dollars" and calls for full transparency in district finances.

(2023) Floated a district parental-notification policy covering gender identity, mental health, bullying and drug abuse; told the board it was not "a forced outing policy" but "full transparency," adding "If the parents knew that their kids were having issues, they could have kept a better eye on things."

source.title: KHTS: Community Members Voice Concerns About Potential Hart District Parental-Notification System (Nov. 2023)

stacy-fortner.text: Says she is passionate about "strong public schools, protecting intellectual freedom, supporting student mental health," and environments where every student feels safe and valued.

stacy-fortner.text: "I want every student no matter who they are, who they love, or what they choose for their future to feel safe, loved, and that they belong here."
